mapper.select: SELECT code_seq AS code_seq, code_grp_cd AS code_grp_cd, code_cd AS code_cd, code_nm AS code_nm, code_desc AS code_desc, COALESCE(sort_ord, 0) AS sort_ord, COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') AS use_yn FROM adm_code_mst WHERE COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY code_grp_cd, COALESCE(sort_ord, 0), code_seq
mapper.insert:
